bullets: If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0 ⇒ δ_i = -1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0
If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0 ⇒ δ_i = +1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0
Minimize the Error using Gradient Descent with step η
equations: Error = Σ_{all misclassified vectors (i)} δ_i W^T X_i
(W^T X_i) takes positive and negative values and δ_i has the same sign
W^(updated) = W^old - η Σ_{misclassified vectors ONLY (i)} δ_i X_i

layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin red rectangular frame enclosing the content (approx. x 6%-94%, y 7%-91%). Centered red bold title at the top; a yellow circular slide-number badge at the top-right corner inside the frame. Below the title, three stacked full-width panels: (1) a square-cornered red-outlined white box defining δ_i, (2) a rounded red-outlined white box redefining the Error function, (3) a rounded red-outlined pale-peach box containing the gradient-descent update, with two light-green rounded sub-boxes side by side at its bottom separated by a red caption and arrow. A black horizontal bar (video-player overlay) runs along the very bottom edge of the image.

layout.hierarchy: The large bold red centered title dominates. typography_notes: Mixed typography: the title and most body text are in a bold/regular sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like); the explanatory clauses ('(W^T X_i) takes positive and negative values and δ_i has the same sign', 'Summation is always', 'Minimize the Error using', 'with step η') and the summation subscripts are set in a smaller serif italic (Times/Cambria-like). Title is large (~28-30 pt) bold red, centered. Panel headings are bold black ~16-18 pt. Body lines ~14-16 pt. Display equations in the peach panel are larger (~18-20 pt) bold serif. Emphasis conventions: 'class I' and 'Class I' in bold red italic, 'class II' and 'Class II' in bold blue italic, 'misclassified as' in black italic, 'd(X)' in black italic, '<0' and '>0' in bold red, 'δ_i' and 'X_i' in bold green, 'Gradient Descent' in bold red italic, 'positive' in bold red italic, 'Minimize the Error using' underlined. The word 'where' is bold black sans-serif. No bullet glyphs are used; lines are flush-left.
animation_state: No visible build animation; all three panels, both green boxes, the caption and arrow are fully present. The only non-slide elements are the mouse cursor and the black video-player bar at the bottom.
recreation_brief: 1) Create a 16:9 white slide (#FFFFFF). 2) Draw a thin 1 pt red (#FF0000) rectangle outline framing the content area, roughly from 6% to 94% of slide width and 7% to 91% of slide height. 3) Add the centered title 'Problem Formulation' in bold red (#C00000), Arial/Calibri, ~30 pt, at the top (about 10-16% down). 4) At the top-right inside the frame, add an oval ~0.9 inch wide filled #FFF68F with a #800080 outline and the black numeral '4' centered in it, ~14 pt. 5) Add Panel 1: a white rectangle with a 1 pt red border and square corners, spanning ~7%-91% width and ~19%-37% height. Inside it, left-aligned, add 'Define ' (bold black) + 'δ_i' (bold green #00B050) + ' as:' (bold black). 6) Add the line 'If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0 ⇒ δ_i = -1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0' with: 'If X ∈' black, 'class I' bold red italic, 'and' black, 'misclassified as' black italic, 'Class II' bold blue (#0000FF) italic, 'then d(X) will be' black with 'd(X)' italic, '<0' bold red, '⇒' black, 'δ_i' bold green, '= -1' black, '⇒' black, 'd(X)' black italic, 'δ_i' bold green, '>0' black. 7) Add the line 'If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0 ⇒ δ_i = +1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0' with 'class II' bold blue italic, 'Class I' bold red italic, '>0' bold red, 'δ_i' bold green, '= +1' black, and the same trailing '⇒ d(X) δ_i >0' styling. 8) Add Panel 2: a white rounded rectangle with a ~1.5 pt red border spanning ~7%-93% width and ~40%-58% height. Inside, add the bold heading 'Redefine Error function as:'. 9) Add the display line 'Error = Σ δ_i W^T X_i ⇒ (W^T X_i) takes positive and negative values and δ_i has the same sign' with 'Error =' bold black, a large Σ with the small red italic subscript 'all misclassified vectors (i)' beneath it, 'δ_i' bold green, 'W^T X_i' with 'X_i' bold green, '⇒' black, and the trailing clause in smaller black serif italic with 'δ_i' green. 10) Add 'Summation is always positive' in black serif italic with 'positive' in bold red italic. 11) Add Panel 3: a rounded rectangle with a ~1.5 pt red border and pale peach fill (#FDEADA), spanning ~7%-93% width and ~60%-91% height. 12) Add the heading 'Minimize the Error using' (black serif italic, underlined) + 'Gradient Descent' (bold red italic) + 'with step η' (black serif italic). 13) Add the large equation 'W^(updated) = W^old - η ∂Error/∂W' (bold serif, 'η' red, superscripts 'updated' and 'old'), then the bold word 'where', then '∂Error/∂W = Σ δ_i X_i' with a large Σ and the small red italic subscript 'misclassified vectors' beneath it, 'δ_i' and 'X_i' in bold green. 14) Add the left green rounded rectangle (fill #E2EFDA, border #00B050, ~1.5 pt) at the bottom-left of Panel 3 containing 'W^(updated) = W^old - η Σ δ_i X_i' with 'η' red, 'δ_i'/'X_i' green, and the small red italic subscript 'misclassified vectors ONLY (i)' under the Σ. 15) Between the green boxes add the red caption 'Update after each sample' (~12-13 pt) and, just below it, a small red left-pointing arrow (short shaft with triangular head and diagonal tail). 16) Add the right green rounded rectangle (same fill/border) containing 'W^(updated) = W^old - η δ_i X_i' with 'η' red and 'δ_i'/'X_i' green. 17) Optionally overlay a solid black rectangle across the bottom of the frame (approx. 4%-93% width, 92%-95% height) to reproduce the video-player bar visible in the source image.
